meta.name: seo-seranking
meta.description: SE Ranking AI visibility analyst (extension). Tracks AI Share-of-Voice across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and AI Mode in a single query. Highest-impact new extension per the v2 gap analysis — no other vendor covers all 5 AI platforms in one API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪品牌在AI搜索中的可见度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责品牌在AI搜索中的曝光度监测
copy.tagline_en: Track brand visibility across AI search platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you monitor brand exposure in AI search results

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询品牌在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Google AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 五个 AI 平台上的提及率，并返回百分比和置信度。还能查询关键词的搜索引擎排名、网站的反向链接和竞争对手分析。
howto.when: 当用户输入以“/seo seranking”开头的命令，并指定品牌、关键词或网址时触发。例如输入“/seo seranking ai-visibility 品牌名”即可查询 AI 可见度。

say.text: 查询品牌“ABC”在 AI 平台上的可见度。
查看关键词“SEO工具”的搜索引擎排名。
say.note: Claude 会返回前100名自然排名和 SERP 特征。

say.text: 分析网站 example.com 的反向链接。
say.note: Claude 会返回反向链接概况。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the brand mention rate across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and AI Mode, returning percentages and confidence notes. It can also query search engine rankings for keywords, backlinks for a URL, and competitor analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user enters a command starting with "/seo seranking" followed by a brand, keyword, or URL. For example, "/seo seranking ai-visibility brandname" queries AI visibility.

say_en.note: Claude calls SE Ranking API and returns mention rate per platform.

say_en.text: Show search engine rankings for keyword "SEO tools".
say_en.note: Claude returns top 100 organic positions and SERP features.
